messages:
sophie_partnerships: @here NW-3021 (NimbusWorks) is blocked in the marketplace. Portal rejects with EXPORT_RESTRICTION and SKU_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH. Customer says customs won't release pallets without cleared classification. Need quick unblock.

carlos_procure: pulling the PO now. Ledger shows product code NW-HW-9 flagged as 'dual-use' by our classification service; partner submitted ECCN field blank in EDI. Portal validation fails on export checks.

ops_bot: Automated alert: PO NW-3021 validation error {"code": 460, "msg": "EXPORT_RESTRICTION: ECCN missing or conflicts with SKU classification"} 

micah_sales: Nimbus says they shipped from US warehouse and believed the SKU was ECCN EAR99. Their shipping docs used old product taxonomy. They can supply an End-User Certificate and corrected EDI but timing is tight (customer wants install next week).

irma_legal: Quick legal framing: if it's EAR99 we can accept EUD + supplier attestation. If it's higher control (e.g., 5D002) we need export license and OOS review. Procurement should confirm vendor ECCN and provide supporting docs.

sophie_partnerships: Can procurement request the vendor ECCN + EUD now? If vendor confirms EAR99 we can patch alias to bypass export block after docs uploaded & legal sign-off.

carlos_procure: Reached out to Nimbus ops. Asking for: 1) ECCN classification statement, 2) End-User Declaration (signed), 3) corrected EDI with ECCN populated.

nimbus_vendor: From NimbusWorks logistics: attaching docs now. EUD uploaded: https://files.redwood/nimbus/EUD-NW-3021.pdf. ECCN claim: EAR99. Corrected EDI pushed (payload snippet below).

nimbus_vendor: ```xml
<PO id="NW-3021">
  <Item sku="NW-HW-9" eccn="EAR99" />
  <Vendor signer_fp="0xA1B2..." />
</PO>
```

ops_bot: Received corrected EDI and EUD. Queuing export-validation re-check job (job id 66022).

ops_bot: Export-validation job completed: ECCN=EAR99 matched. Suggested action: alias-patch to accept EAR99 for NW-HW-9 and reattempt portal ACK.

irma_legal: I have the EUD and vendor attestation. EAR99 looks correct based on docs provided. I'll mark legal clearance for export and add audit note with reference: contracts#NW-3021-EUD.

sophie_partnerships: Ops: can you apply alias patch to allow EAR99 and force a portal retry? Also note legal clearance id for audit.

ops_bot: alias-patch queued: `alias-patch --vendor NW --po NW-3021 --allow-eccn=EAR99` (job id 66024). ETA ~90s.

ops_bot: alias-patch completed (job id 66024). Portal retry issued.

micah_sales: Customer reports portal shows ACK accepted now. Logistics confirmed labels printed. Thank you team.

carlos_procure: Uploaded vendor attestation & EUD to PO ledger: https://files.redwood/nimbus/NW-3021-eud-attest.pdf. Closing procurement action.

irma_legal: Added legal stamp and audit entry. Leaving note: if vendor later changes ECCN we must re-evaluate export license requirements.

sophie_partnerships: Closing thread: portal accepted, shipping can proceed. If customs flags anything we reopen. Great cross-team move. :rocket:
